name: Fonta: Lakelight Luminescence
description:
"Refreshing Fonta, a Font of Refreshment"
Specially flavored Fonta, said to use Fontainian Lakelight Lilies as an ingredient. When used as the theme for a Card Back, it seems to spark the player's energy and give them a competitive boost...
